messages:
Leah K: Heads-up — thinking about a small 'cost provenance' badge in the rollout rail that explains where the mini cost number comes from (sampling, model histograms, kv_hits). Need to avoid product misinterpretation. Quick takes?
Sam R: Strong +1. Users will see a single number and assume it's exact. We should call out 'estimated' and give a one-click link to the underlying signals.
Owen T: backend constraints: we already emit per-request token_count and kv_hit bools, but not a consolidated per-route prefetch credit. We can compute an estimate server-side with a 1m rollup, or compute client-side from primitives. Which do we want?
Leah K: prefer server-side rollup to keep the front-end lightweight and consistent across clients. But we must version the estimate formula so older dashboards remain reproducible.
Sam R: Agreed on server-side + version tag. Also we need provenance fields: sample_rate, model_histogram_version, calculation_version, and a confidence band. UI can show "Est: 12.3k ± 18% (v2)".
Owen T: implementing sample_rate & calc_version is straightforward. Confidence band needs a little stats: use bootstrap on sampled token-histograms. Could be done async in rollup job.
Leah K: UX: show the primary numeric as 'Effective tokens (est)' and a small info icon. Clicking opens a tiny panel with: breakdown (gross, cache_est, kv_hits), provenance (sample_rate, hist_version, calc_version), and link to runbook. Keep copy short.
Sam R: runbook snippet suggestion: if card jumps >30% vs prior week but invoice flat -> 1) check routing sticky flags 2) check prefetch warmup windows 3) check sample_rate drift 4) run offline reconciliation job (path: /ops/cost/recon).
Owen T: edge case: shared prefetch keys across routes will inflate estimated savings if we naively multiply kv_hits * avg_cached_tokens. For now, add a 'shared_prefetch_possible' flag when our trace table shows the same cache_key across >1 route in the last hour. UI can surface a yellow warning.
Leah K: good. That warning should link to a deep-dive doc explaining attribution strategies (pro-rate by first-touch, pro-rate by hit shares, or attribute to pool). We should avoid transactional billing language.
Sam R: rollout plan: feature flag + server-side calc v1 -> internal teams for 2 weeks -> dark launch to 10% of org -> compare estimate to nightly batch recon; if median error < 15% we flip 100%. Add monitoring alert when median error > 25% for 24h.
Owen T: I'll add the rollup job, emit the provenance fields, and stash the calc_version in the metric tag. Will add a lightweight endpoint to request offline recon for route_id.
Leah K: I'll draft UI copy and the small panel mock. Keep the card compact: main number + tiny chevron for panel. No sparkline in MVP to save space.
Sam R: I'll write the runbook and add the monitoring alert recipe. Also add a tiny telemetry metric: cost_provenance_warning_count to track how often we surface the shared-prefetch warning.
Owen T: PR plan: backend rollup -> feature flag switch -> add provenance tags -> front-end card + panel -> telemetry/alerting. Tagging deploy-bot for canary.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for branch "eng/cost-provenance-rail" to staging at 2024-09-18T15:00:00Z :rocket:
Leah K: perfect. leaving thread open for PR links and wording tweaks. Thanks! :seedling:
